records.text: Intervention effect. Base system: Cr18Mn27Fe27.5Ni27.5 high entropy alloy (HEA). Intervention: Exposure to molten FLiBe salt. Processing: 700 °C for 1000 hours. Test conditions: Molten FLiBe salt (2LiF-BeF2), 700 °C, 1000 hours. Structure change: Precipitation of a BCC phase (Cr67Fe13Mn18.5Ni1.5) and needle-shaped Cr-rich particles in near-surface regions. Property change: Mass loss of 3.4 mg/cm² (higher than 316 H stainless steel's 0.26 mg/cm²). Mechanism: Dissolution of Mn into the molten salt, which hinders the dissolution of Cr. Evidence: measured. Quote: "Results show that the HEA lost a higher mass compared to the reference 316 H stainless steel due to the dissolution of Mn into the molten salt."
